title: Tailwise Training Absence Policy: Notice, Forfeits, Makeups and Reschedules
content:
Tailwise Training treats a missed session as excused or unexcused according to the notice the customer gave, with separate terms for a female in heat and for a session Tailwise itself cancels.

## Policy

**A. Excused absence.** An absence is excused only if notice is given at least the course's excused-absence notice hours before the session start. Notice is counted in full elapsed hours from the moment the customer's notice is recorded to the session date and start time; notice of exactly the notice hours is excused.

**B. Female in heat.** A female in heat is excused regardless of notice where the course excuses a female in heat.

**C. Session cancelled by Tailwise.** A session cancelled by Tailwise is credited, and rescheduled, where the course credits sessions cancelled by Tailwise.

**D. Unexcused absence.** An unexcused absence uses the session where the course provides that an absence without enough notice uses it.

**E. Makeups (group).** An excused group session may be made up in another class of the same course up to the course's makeup allowance, counted over the enrollment, within the course's makeup window in calendar days after the last scheduled session.

**F. Reschedules (private).** A private session given enough notice is rescheduled, up to the course's private reschedule allowance.

The notice hours, makeup allowance, makeup window and reschedule allowance are each course's own figures in the Tailwise Training absence notice and makeup allowances.

## The notice test (A) in detail

| Element | What it is |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | The moment the customer's notice is recorded |
| Clock stops | The session's scheduled date and start time, as shown on the session record |
| Unit | Full elapsed hours; a part hour is not counted |
| Test | Full hours of notice are not fewer than the course's notice hours |
| At the boundary | Notice of exactly the notice hours is excused |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a course whose notice period is 24 hours)

| Notice recorded before the session start | Full elapsed hours | Excused under A |
|---|---|---|
| 24 hours 40 minutes | 24 | Yes |
| Exactly 24 hours | 24 | Yes |
| 23 hours 59 minutes | 23 | No |

For a session starting at 6:00 pm on a Saturday, notice recorded at 6:00 pm on the Friday is exactly 24 full hours and is excused; notice recorded at 6:30 pm on the Friday is 23 full hours and is not excused under A.

## How a missed session is treated

| Missed session | Excused? | Effect on the session |
|---|---|---|
| Notice given that meets A | Yes | Group: may be made up under E. Private: rescheduled under F, up to the reschedule allowance |
| Female in heat, course excusing a female in heat (B) | Yes, whatever the notice | Excused with makeup credit |
| Cancelled by Tailwise, course crediting such sessions (C) | Credited | The session is credited and rescheduled |
| Not excused, course providing that an unexcused absence uses the session (D) | No | The session is used (forfeited) |

## Worked example (hypothetical group enrollment with a makeup allowance of 2)

The dog misses session 2 with 30 hours' notice and session 4 with 26 hours' notice; both are excused under A. Both may be made up in other classes of the same course within the makeup window after the course's last scheduled session, using the full allowance of 2. The dog then misses session 5 with 10 hours' notice, no other excuse applying: the absence is unexcused and, on a course where an unexcused absence uses the session, session 5 is used.
